newsitem.title: JAPAN: Intel, Sharp to sell high-density flash component.
newsitem.headline: Intel, Sharp to sell high-density flash component.

text.p: Intel Corp and Sharp Corp said on Wednesday they had jointly developed "high-density, fast-write" flash memory devices and would manufacture and market them for the global market.

The 16- and 32-megabit flash components are suitable for networking and telecommunications equipment, fax machines, printers and copiers, mobile phones and terminals, the two firms said in a statement.

The new products are supported by the Common Flash Memory Interface (CFI), which helps ensure software compatability between flash products from different companies, and between current flash products and future products, they said.
The companies said they will begin trial samples of the 16-megabit device on July 10 and of the 32-megabit device in the fourth quarter of 1997.
